title: Austin: Gas Tanks, Alley Sheds, Tin Roofs
summary:
*   **Early Auto Infrastructure:** Approved a permit for an underground gasoline tank and curb pump at 40th & Guadalupe, reflecting the growing presence of automobiles.
*   **Urban Development Permits:** Granted permits for new construction, including a material shack in an alley between the Littlefield and Driskill Hotel buildings, and a tin roof for a building on Congress Avenue.
*   **Utility Account Adjustments:** Authorized the Water, Light, and Power Department to settle accounts with the Consumers Fuel & Ice Co. by accepting approved company accounts against the City.
*   **Public Fine Remission:** Overturned a fine and costs previously assessed against Willie Wolter in the Recorder's Court.

fine remitted

The Chair laid before the Council the following petition : July 13th 1915.
To the Hon Mayor & City Council of Austin , Gentlemen : I hereby petition your Hon body

Building Permit both sides.

July 18th ,1915 . All present except the Mayor: Councilman Haynes offered the following
resolution :

Resolved by the City Council of the City of Austin, Texas: That in order to adjust the
accounts of the Water, Light and Power Dept of the City of Austin ,against the Consumers
Fuel & Ice Co ,the Supt of the Water,Light and Power Dept is authorized to receive from
said Consumers Fuel & Ice Co,such approved accounts as they may have against the City ,and
until further notice, to credit same to the accounts of said Co,on the Books of the Water,
Light and Power Dept.

Accounts
